talent_gap.negative: The opponent was stronger on paper: {value} points (rating {mean_r} against {opp}).

fatigue.negative: Fatigue cost you {value} points: your starters averaged {avg_fatigue} Fatigue.

luck.negative: Luck cost you {value} points: the breaks went the other way.

close_game: This game was extremely close and came down to small margins and luck.

coach_tips.fatigue: Fatigue was your biggest controllable loss. Recovery and Wellness lowers Fatigue for the whole roster.

coach_tips.talent_gap: The opponent has more talent. Focused Training grows your best prospects.
